1
Rab Khair Kare Teri Veran Mera Dill Darda.
Sughra De Waang Na Wichri Kitay Mar Jaan Veer Raza.
Ik Wekhaan Roz Janaza Mainu Khuwabaan Bohat Draya.
Tere Sir Te Wekhiya Veran Main Ujari Maut Da Saya.
Nahin Mashhad Choon Koi Aayi Teri Khair Di Veer Itela.
Haye Hijar Bhirawaan De Na Shala Kadi Wekhan Bhaina.
Mainu Mariya Veer Jodaiyaan Main Ujari Hoor Ki Kehna.
Assi Jeenday Fair Miley Na Ainj Wichrey Bhain Bhira.
Mil Zehar Gayi Aye Mainu Kehya Ro Ke Pak Raza Aye.
Tere Dardaan Taun Main Sadqay Tainu Milda Gal Main La Ke.
Mehmaan Haan Lahzay Da Main Tere Veer De Muk Gaye Sah.
Do Bhaina Do Veraan Di Payi Loko Ajab Judai.
Ik Dhi Mosa Kazim Di Doji Shabbir Di Jayi.
Ik Mar Gayi Mashhad Jandi Ik Takdi Veer De Rah.
Masooma Qum Nu Deway Jehra Veer Raza Da Pursa.
 Sajjad Duawaan Deway Ohno Ro Ro Bibi Zahra.
Jehra Matami Karda Matam Aoulad-e-Muhammad Da.

Reconstructed all 17 verses in Shahmukhi Punjabi and preserved their wording and order in `romanLyrics`. Updated the titles and script metadata, removed the resolved `noUrdu` tag, and verified that both editions have one stanza with 17 verses. The diff passed the whitespace check.

I rendered the ambiguous readings “Veran” as ویراں and “Mil zehar” as مل زہر.
